# Bundled Browser Libraries

The workbench loads these files locally so icons and graphs remain available without Internet access.

| Library | Version | Source | License |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Lucide | 0.468.0 | https://unpkg.com/lucide@0.468.0/dist/umd/lucide.min.js | ISC, see LICENSE-lucide |
| D3 | 7.9.0 | https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/d3@7.9.0/dist/d3.min.js | ISC, see LICENSE-d3 |

Keep upstream copyright headers and license files when updating these assets.
